steps.caption: Open the Peregrine Loom Studios signal from Signals.
Decide: Approve + task, Investigate, Assign to me, Already known and Re-assess.
Approve + task: the signal is approved and a follow-up task is created in Tasks.
The status changes and History records the decision and the new follow-up task.
Task: create another task with your own title. Opportunity: link an existing deal, or propose a new one — it goes to Review for approval.
Now the Quillstone Labs funding signal. Funding alone is not an office requirement, so it is ranked low.
Override priority: choose Medium, give the reason and a date to review it.
Save override. The priority shows it was overridden, and Clear override undoes it.
Snooze until a date — it comes back on its own then.
Dismiss or Reject needs a reason. Dismiss the Quillstone expansion: the hires are remote.
Dismissed and snoozed signals move to their own view — nothing is deleted. Reopen brings one back.
